decision: Project-owned source for selected USA BIOS and DOS messages; retains only the three core-related message sections.
basis: MSBIO and MSDOS sections derive from the previously documented Astro and v5 diagnostic candidate; MSBIO message IDs 18, 23, 34 and 36 were reconstructed against the target.
BOOT section derives from the documented Astro USA IBM message input.
Optional POWER entry is inferred from prior v5 research; its exact historical provenance remains unproven.
verification: Fresh IO.SYS and MSDOS.SYS builds from this project message file match their target files byte for byte.
limitations: Tool executables and build runner remain external pinned dependencies. COMMAND messages and fully self-contained reproducible build remain open.
